message:
The users API test passes now. `npm test` reports 1 pass and 0 failures.

**Cause:** The test failed with `unknown column users.full_name`. Migration `001_create_users.js` creates the column as `fullname`, but `src/api/users.js` wrote and read `full_name`. The in-memory `Db` rejects any column the table doesn't have.

**Fix:** In `src/api/users.js`, I changed the two `full_name` references to `fullname` to match the schema. The change is in `createUser` and `getUser`.

I didn't touch the migrations. `.fenceline/fences.json` blocks edits under `migrations/**` (the DBA team owns them), and migration 001 has already run in production, so renaming its column wouldn't change production anyway. The code now matches the schema as it is.

The change is uncommitted; `git status` shows only `src/api/users.js` modified. I didn't commit because you didn't ask for one.
text: Fenceline: no fence crossed this turn.
